senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (खेटति)
To alarm.
r. 10th cl. (खेटयति)
To eat.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Vile, bad, low.
2 Armed, having a weapon or weapons.
mn. (-टः-टं)
Hunting, the chase; also आखेट.
m. (-टः)
1 A shield.
2 A village, the residence of peasants or farmers.
3 A small town, half the Pura or town.
4 The club of BALARĀMA.
5 Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humour.
6 The ascending node or RĀHU.
7 A horse.
n. (-टं)
Grass.
E.
खिट to terrify, &c. affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A village, the residence of agricultural peasants.
2 A shield.
3 The club of BALARĀMA.
E.
खिट to terrify, &c. अच् affix, and कन् added.

m. (-लः)
A minstrel, a family bard or piper, whose business it is to awaken the Laird, with music and singing.
E.
खेटि derived from खिट to disturb, and ताल tune.

m. (-टी)
A lecher, a libertine.
E.
खेट sport, affix इनि.
